A well-stocked store, we found these kibbles at the lowest price around, on sale.
There are so many varieties of boxes, so many unique flavors, so much to choose from.
The new store has moved to the former Zara location; it's bigger, prettier, and has more things here.

Unfortunately, I can't give less than one star because it's not possible.
The store is well-stocked, but it's a shame the staff is untrained and rude.
This morning, I was looking for some products and was answered by Giulia, an employee... Down there, after wandering around for half an hour, I went to a lady in another department who rightly agreed with me! As if that weren't enough, I asked her if the brush I'd chosen for my dog ​​was always good. Her very specific response was: "What brush do you have?" A typical response from someone who knows nothing and isn't informed about the products they sell! Dear sales assistant, go do something else or learn more about what you sell because that's what you're there for.
Cheaper than other stores
Well-stocked. And competitive prices. Daily offers. Excellent shop.

The store is always very well stocked. The mall's parking is very convenient (free for the first two hours) and it's close to the highway. The only drawback is that there are only two small self-service checkouts, and there are often lines on weekends.

A very well-stocked shop with all the products for our furry friends. Cats, dogs, and even small pets. Not just food (wet and dry), but also clothing, harnesses and leashes, toys, decorative items, scratching posts, holiday treats like the famous Canettone or themed biscuits at Christmas, Canovo biscuits at Easter, treats, and, of course, litter boxes. I even purchased decorative plaques with the breeds of my dogs and cats. There's everything for our furry friends, who can even be present. Great prices, offers, and promotions. There are also some health products, like Feliway and Camon.
I've always had a great experience. Excellent variety of products and friendly staff.

Hello Culinandi Del Po,
Thank you for taking the time to review our store.
Customer satisfaction is our strength!
See you soon
Iper La grande i
I bought some really nice products for my dear son. They are clean and great for pets.
The number indicated on Google is incorrect. The staff present is very poorly trained.

Very rude staff. I came here yesterday to inquire. I lost my receipt, so I haven't been here since I bought 52 cans and my cat didn't eat them. I'm hoping it can be replaced, so the staff printed out a receipt for my membership card and asked me to bring the product today. I said I'd bought more in November and bought 52 cans of cat food, and they asked me to come by and exchange it. But today I brought the product, and yesterday the staff wasn't there. I encountered a staff member with a nasty facial expression and a bit of discrimination who refused to replace me with a product of equal value. The attitude was terrible: what he said is the rules, and what others say doesn't matter.

8.15pm: The cash register closed, which had been operational for 5 minutes so it wasn't broken, a queue at the self-service checkout is inevitable... I understand that it's late and I really want to go home, but closing a cash register and cleaning it before closing seems excessive to me.

They only installed self-service checkouts, so you'll find the guy who lost his ATM code, the one who doesn't understand how to do it, the one who skips the line... BIG MISTAKE. So much, so much wasted time... I'll never go there again.
Self-checkout lines are creating queues. Good selection.
They don't refund broken items they sell you. Shame on you!

Honestly... No. The selection is excellent: vast and well-priced. However, the fact that there are only self-checkouts is a bit of a turnoff. The employees just stand there looking at you as if you were about to rob the store, their arms crossed as you pass your groceries. Honestly, it's a service that should be offered, especially since not everyone knows how to use it. (In fact, the line builds up faster.)
They should learn how to answer the phone. Terrible.

I reconsidered my previous comment, as the store currently offers generous discounts, alternating with various promotions that other stores, including Arcaplanet, can't match. The prices of dry food, from all brands, including Royal Canin, are lower than those of Milan's established pet food retailers. I recommend visiting for a bargain!
Customer care from 1 to 5 I would say 0
Pet supplies store: it's well-stocked and has a bit of everything; prices are a bit high.
Incompetent staff
